state.invariant: time-indexed internal configuration only when source-grounded
state.forbidden_collapse: Do not treat all states as the same computational or biological object.

memory.invariant: retained source-defined structure accessible across relevant succession
paper_specific: compressed episodic latent / semantic model distinction
SORN weights/cached aim only where source treats persistence
memory.forbidden_collapse: External history, delay or latent state-estimation posterior is not automatically memory.

prediction.invariant: source-defined generation/estimation of not-currently-observed structure or consequence
paper_specific: SR future occupancy / PR predecessor relation
prediction.forbidden_collapse: Prediction error, retrieval output and likelihood are not automatically prediction state.

policy.invariant: source-defined action mapping/selection rule, not the generic P interface
policy.forbidden_collapse: Execution interface alone is not a persistent policy.

representation.invariant: source-defined internal carrier; type and persistence vary by paper
representation.forbidden_collapse: Shared label does not imply shared mechanism.

skill.invariant: source-defined learned action/execution competence or motor mapping
paper_specific: SKL-02 sequence-sensitive recurrent state + supervised readout
skill.forbidden_collapse: External target/body is not skill state.

replay.forbidden_collapse: No replay mechanism is invented in M3; retrieval, reconstruction or repeated training is not relabeled replay.

model.invariant: source-defined generative/transition/control structure; distinguish fixed world structure, learned parameters and current latent state
paper_specific: PRD-03 experiment-defined transition model plus internal posterior
model.forbidden_collapse: A model parameter is not automatically an online controller.
